references.text: Naomi's confirmation that Ruth has found safe refuge in Boaz's protection, corresponding to her original search for grace.
Boaz's instruction to Ruth to stay with his field is the concrete fulfillment of her prayer to find grace.
Ruth quotes Boaz's earlier instruction to confirm her obedience and safety under his protection.
The contrast between Naomi's desperate call to return and Ruth's initiative to go out in hope of finding grace.
Arrival in Bethlehem at the start of harvest is the necessary precondition for Ruth's initiative to glean.
Naomi's role as guide shifts from urging action (2:2) to encouraging patient waiting (3:18) after Boaz has taken up the matter.
